notes.title: Update 26.10
notes.content:
In this update I added Italian localization and made a small, but very useful addition to the starting platform on the first level: now it reminds you about ability to change your weapons. A lot of people missed it from the tutorial, so they can learn it on the first level now.

Have fun!

notes.title: Update 21.10
notes.content:
That's a small update but pretty useful.
Fixed behavior of round shooters (if sometimes you ended up on a empty platform, but non-zero counter - that's probably because of them)
Cursor is blocked in the game window now - no more misclicks if you are playing with more than one monitor, or in window mode.

Have fun!

notes.title: RELEASE
notes.content:
JASEM is completely and totally released!
During the Early Access it got:
Mac and Linux support
2 new levels
1 new boss
1 new usual enemy
1 new music track
A lot of fixed bugs and tweaked features, and I mean A LOT

So, no more words from me, HAVE FUN, BEAT THE BOSSES OR DIE TRYING!

notes.title: Update 13.10
notes.content:
Level 5 just arrived to JASEM! It's still WIP and could be changed during this week, but it's working with all achievements

Also, you got a hard mode (don't run away, that's not what you thought). After you pass any level once, you can now start it through red portal and it has only one difference from usual: all levers and HoloWalls will be restored to default state each time you die. It's handy if you want to get achievements about passing the level without deaths.

Have fun!

notes.title: Update 10.10
notes.content:
JASEM is getting a bit harder (Yes, it's not a mistake)
* All weapons are open from the start now, but only one of every type. To get a pair of something you should clear the platforms.
* Some minor fixes and layout changes
* Fixed a bug with different music tracks played together
* For Achievement hunting - now you can press T and make a hard level reload * With all the bridges and walls coming back
Have fun! ːjasemangryː
